task.title: Validate dependencies and integration points required for key-based Insert Keyword pop-ups
task.shortdesc: Check editor, plugin, and catalog integrations that provide key resolution so Insert Keyword can display pop-ups for keys defined outside the current file.

step.cmd: {'step': 'Verify XML catalog/URI resolution settings so that all referenced maps and topics can be located when resolving keys (no broken catalog entries or unreachable paths).'}
{'step': 'Confirm that any DITA-OT or editor plugin responsible for key resolution is enabled and at a compatible version with your DITA version and specialization set.'}
{'step': 'If keys point to resources in another repository/module, ensure those resources are mounted/checked out locally and that relative paths resolve from the root map location.'}
{'step': 'Check for duplicate key names across merged maps; if duplicates exist, rename or consolidate to avoid non-deterministic resolution that can prevent Insert Keyword suggestions.'}
{'step': 'Validate that key targets are of supported types for pop-up insertion in your tool (for example, topics/terms) and adjust keydefs to point to appropriate targets if needed.'}

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
